themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, Italy, and Poland are advancing policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize nationalist agendas across Europe, often clashing with EU norms on equality and non-discrimination.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in housing, education, and social aid, sparking legal and political debates in Andalusia and other regions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government advocates for EU-wide migrant repatriation hubs, aligning with Denmark and Netherlands on strict migration policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Supports policies favoring Polish citizens in healthcare and social benefits, often framing them as protection against EU overreach.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's visit to Poland underscores shared anti-immigration stance, advocating for stricter border controls and national preference in public services.

themes.title: Diplomatic fallout from Trump-Meloni tensions
themes.blurb: The public feud between Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has escalated into a diplomatic crisis, with Italy canceling high-level visits and EU leaders expressing solidarity with Meloni. This theme highlights the fragility of transatlantic alliances under far-right leadership and the broader implications for NATO and EU-US relations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's repeated insults toward Meloni, including claims she 'begged' for a photo, have strained US-Italy relations and drawn bipartisan condemnation in the US.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces internal and external backlash, with Foreign Minister Tajani canceling a US trip and EU leaders rallying behind her.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French leaders, including Macron and Le Pen, publicly support Meloni, framing Trump's remarks as an attack on European sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish PM Sánchez expresses solidarity with Meloni, condemning Trump's 'unacceptable' behavior and calling for stronger EU unity.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine diplomatic crisis over WWII legacy
themes.blurb: Poland's decision to strip Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of the Order of the White Eagle over Ukraine's naming of a military unit after the WWII-era Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) has triggered a diplomatic crisis. This theme reflects the resurgence of historical grievances in Eastern Europe and their impact on contemporary geopolitical alliances.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Nawrocki revokes Zelenskyy's honor, citing Ukraine's glorification of UPA, which Poland accuses of massacring Poles during WWII.

countries.name: 🇺🇦 Ukraine (external)
countries.note: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Sybiha returns Poland's Commander's Cross in protest, escalating tensions amid ongoing EU accession talks.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's meeting with Polish leaders underscores far-right solidarity on historical memory and opposition to Ukraine's EU accession.

countries.name: 🇪🇺 EU (external)
countries.note: EU leaders express concern over the diplomatic rift, fearing it could undermine Ukraine's EU accession process and regional stability.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and scandals. This theme highlights the fragility of far-right coalitions and the personalistic nature of their leadership, often leading to public infighting and strategic realignments.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini's Lega faces internal rebellion over leadership and alliances, with figures like Vannacci challenging Salvini's authority and Meloni distancing herself from the party.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government is fractured by infighting between factions led by Karina Milei, Victoria Villarruel, and Manuel Adorni, with Adorni facing calls for resignation over corruption allegations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's party suffers electoral setbacks and internal criticism over candidate selection and messaging, with Makerfield by-election loss exposing strategic flaws.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces internal power struggles, with state-level factions challenging national leadership and scandals undermining public support.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's ruling Fidesz faces defections and criticism from the new Tisza party, which accuses Orbán of corruption and authoritarianism.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal dominates Argentine discourse

This theme reflects the broader challenges of corruption and transparency in far-right governments, with Adorni's case serving as a litmus test for Javier Milei's anti-corruption rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni faces judicial investigation and congressional censure over undeclared savings and luxury purchases, with Milei's government rallying behind him despite public backlash.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: US media outlets amplify the scandal, framing it as a test of Milei's commitment to anti-corruption and economic reform.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right media covers the scandal, drawing parallels to corruption cases in Spain and criticizing Milei's handling of the crisis.
